_no_data_block: DELIBERATE. With no `data:` block train.py streams TinyStories straight from HuggingFace at the pinned revision (HUB_SHA f54c09fd...) and needs no infrastructure at all -- no chuk-datasets, no control plane, no join token. That is what makes this config runnable from one Colab cell today, while the catalog route is blocked on a read-scoped key. Cost of the choice, stated plainly: the tokenizer runs on the worker, and token ORDER comes from this seed rather than from a content-addressed artifact, so this run is reproducible-given-the-seed but not bit-reproducible the way configs/real.json is. Use real.json for the filmed Act 1e dispatch once the key exists.
_guards: Two of train.py's four refusals cannot fire without a `data:` block, because there are no staged shards to check: the content_sha pin and the decode-to-English test. The two that DO fire are the ones that matter for a fresh pretrain -- the vendored tokenizer must hash to the published v11 build, and config.json's vocab_size must equal the tokenizer's. The corpus identity here rests on HuggingFace's pinned revision instead.
_milestones: The five canonical emergence captures (0 / 100k / 1M / 5M / 16M) plus 2M, 8M and 12M. The extras are pure insurance against a Colab disconnect: a drop then costs at most ~4M tokens of work instead of ~11M, and CHUK_RESUME_CKPT picks up from the last one. The emergence table takes whichever five it wants.
